key.name: style
key.description: “system”: light or dark following GNOME, “light”/“dark”: set by hand.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the last closed window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the last closed window in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the last closed window was maximized.

key.name: confirm-close
key.description: Ask before closing a pane, tab or window in which a program is still running.

key.name: copy-on-select
key.description: Selected text goes to the clipboard at once, like in Tilix; the primary selection (middle click) works anyway.

key.name: warn-multiline-paste
key.description: When pasting multi-line text (Ctrl+Shift+V, context menu), show it first and ask for confirmation.

key.name: pane-title
key.description: “floating”: floating title at the top right (default), “row”: title bar above each pane.

key.name: dim-unfocused
key.description: In split tabs, slightly dim the panes without focus.

key.name: context-colors
key.summary: Context color for root and SSH
key.description: Mark panes running a program with root privileges or an SSH connection with a line, a chip and a tinted background. The colors come from the color scheme.

key.name: follow-high-contrast
key.description: When “High Contrast” is turned on in GNOME, all panes use the “High Contrast” color scheme instead of the scheme from the profile.

key.name: tab-label-template
key.description: Placeholders: {n} number, {program} program, {dir} folder, {path} full path, {host} host for SSH, {title} shell title, {profile} profile. Empty values are dropped together with their separator.

key.name: window-title-template
key.description: Placeholders as for tab names, {title} is the tab title (own name or the shell's title).

key.name: short-tab-labels
key.description: Tabs show number, running program and folder (“1 htop · parkett”) instead of the title set by the shell. A name you set yourself takes precedence.

key.name: autohide-tab-bar
key.summary: Hide tab bar with a single tab
key.description: Show the tab bar only when more than one tab is open.

key.name: new-terminal-directory
key.description: “current”: use the directory of the active pane, “home”: start in the home folder.

key.name: default-profile
key.description: Id of the profile for new tabs (file name in ~/.config/parkett/profiles without .toml).

key.name: custom-shortcuts
key.description: Action (e.g. “win.split-right”) → shortcut in GTK notation; empty = shortcut off. Actions not listed use the default shortcut.

key.name: restore-session
key.description: On start, open the windows and tabs of the last session: layout, profiles, directories and custom titles, without the programs running in them.

key.name: notify-command-finished
key.description: Show a notification when a command that ran for at least 10 seconds finishes in a pane that is not visible. Requires the VTE shell integration (vte.sh).

key.name: enable-sixel
key.description: Display images in Sixel format in the terminal. Only works if the installed VTE library is built with Sixel support.

key.name: scrollback-lines
key.description: How many lines each terminal keeps for scrolling back; -1 = unlimited.
